article.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
article.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. article.title: Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms
article.summary: Microsoft closed an Azure API Management flaw exploited to target secrets at Norwegian energy companies, with other sectors also affected. The post Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Lỗ hổng API Management trên Microsoft Azure đã bị kẻ gian khai thác nhằm đánh cắp dữ liệu nhạy cảm của các công ty năng lượng Na Uy.

article.title: GL.iNet cloud compromise hits routers and KVMs, older backdoors also found
article.summary: Attackers compromised GoodCloud, GL.iNet’s cloud remote management service, and used it to install malware on routers and KVM (keyboard, video and mouse) devices connected to it. The Chinese company, best known for its small travel routers, is still investigating, and it’s not yet known how many devices have been affected. article.title: Cleverbridge alerts customers that hackers stole their credit card and CVV numbers
article.summary: Hackers breached e-commerce platform Cleverbridge and made off with payment card data stored on it, the company has confirmed. Cleverbridge handles purchases, payments and subscriptions for other businesses, and its website lists Red Hat, Sony, SUSE, Veeam, Tenable and Jamf among its clients.
